facts.statement: The genus was first named in 1990 by Ziqi Bai, Jie Yang, and Guohui Wang, including the type and only species Yimenosaurus youngi.
facts.quote: The genus was first named in 1990 by Ziqi Bai, Jie Yang and Guohui Wang, along with its type and only species, Yimenosaurus youngi.

facts.statement: In 2010, Paul estimated the animal's length at 9 meters and its weight at 2 tonnes.
facts.quote: In 2010 Paul estimated its length at 9 m and its weight at 2 t.

facts.statement: It possessed a short, deep skull, approximately two-thirds as high as it is long, resembling that of later sauropods, which was extremely gracile with elliptical nostrils and moderately sized semicircular orbits with a long, triangular antorbital fenestra.
facts.quote: Posee un cráneo corto y profundo, aproximadamente 2/3 de alto que de largo, parecido al de los saurópodos posteriores, este es extremadamente grácil, las narinas son elípticas y las órbitas semicirculares y de tamaño moderado con la fenestración anterorbital triangular y larga.

facts.statement: The skull contained 4 premaxillary teeth, 17 and 18 maxillary teeth on the upper and lower jaws respectively, and 21 and 23 dentary teeth.
facts.quote: Presenta 4 dientes premaxilares 17 y 18 maxilares en la parte superior e inferior respectivamente, en el dentario 21 y 23.

facts.statement: The teeth were compact, spoon-shaped, and striated.
facts.quote: Los dientes son compactos y con forma de cuchara, con estrías.

facts.statement: It had a long, strong neck with forelimbs shorter than its hind legs.
facts.quote: El cuello es largo y fuerte, con brazos más cortos que las piernas.

facts.statement: The fifth toe was reduced, the claw of the first toe was robust, while the claws of the second, third, and fourth toes were reduced.
facts.quote: El dedo 5 está reducido, el ungal del dedo 1 es robusto pero el de los dedos 2, 3, 4 están reducidos.

facts.statement: The fossils were found in August 1987 by Mr. Xingyong Zhang, a fossil hunter and assistant at the Yunnan Provincial Museum.
facts.quote: Encontrado en agosto de 1987 por el señor Xingyong Zhang un buscador de fósiles asistente del Museo Provincial de Yunnan.

facts.statement: The specimens were found in the Fengjiahe Formation in Yunnan Province, China.
facts.quote: Se encontraron en la formación Fengjiahe, en la Provincia de Yunnan, China.

facts.statement: The discovery consisted of 3 tonnes of material that was prepared by the regional culture academy.
facts.quote: Consiste en 3 toneladas de material, que fueran preparados por la academia regional de cultura.

facts.statement: The holotype, YXV 8701, consists of a complete skull and mandible lacking only the anterior jaw end and minor orbital bone fragments, along with fragmentary cervical and dorsal vertebrae, all sacral vertebrae, an ilium, both ischia, a complete femur, and incomplete, damaged ribs.
facts.quote: El holotipo, YXV 8701, se conoce a partir de un cráneo completo y una mandíbula a la que solo le falta el extremo anterior de la mandíbula y fragmentos menores de hueso alrededor de la órbita, así como los elementos poscraneales de vértebras cervicales y dorsales fragmentarias , todas vértebras sacras, un ilion, ambos isquiones, un fémur completo, y costillas incompletas y dañadas.

facts.statement: It lived at the beginning of the Jurassic Period, approximately 195 to 190 million years ago, during the Hettangian and Sinemurian stages in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a principios del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 195 y 190 millones de años, en el Hettangiense y el Sinemuriense, en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: The fossil record indicates a time range from 201.4 to 199.5 million years ago during the Hettangian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Hettangian to Hettangian (201.4 to 199.5 million years ago)

facts.statement: Yimenosaurus is classified as a member of the Sauropodomorpha order within the Plateosauridae family.
facts.quote: Yimenosaurus es considerado como un Sauropodomorpha de la familia Plateosauridae.

facts.statement: Recently, its classification has been questioned due to the particular nature of its skull.
facts.quote: Aunque recientemente se ha puesto en duda esto debido a lo particular de su cráneo.

facts.statement: This classification was made in 1990 but without an exact cladistic analysis.
facts.quote: Esta clasificación fue realizada en 1990 pero sin un análisis cladístico exacto.

rejected.statement: Yimenosaurus is an extinct genus of plateosaurid sauropodomorph dinosaur that lived in China during the Early Jurassic.
rejected.quote: Yimenosaurus (meaning "Yimen reptile") is an extinct genus of plateosaurid sauropodomorph dinosaur that lived in China in the Early Jurassic.
